TaskDescription: The Famous Faces and Places (FFP) task used a mixed design, combining event-related and block-based elements. Individual events (i.e., stimuli) varied along two dimensions: domain (face, place) and fame (famous, anonymous). Blocked conditions manipulated the task (N-back vs. Categorization, with selective attention modulated within N-back blocks by instructing participants to attend either to famous or anonymous stimuli).
